question: The National Vaccination Day in India is observed on 16 March every year to commemorate the first administration of which vaccine in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Polio**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Vaccination Day**, also referred to as **National Immunization Day**, is observed in India every year on **16 March**.
 
• The primary objective of this day is to convey the significance of **vaccination** to the general public and to recognize the efforts of **healthcare professionals** and frontline workers in ensuring **public health**.
 
• This specific date was chosen to commemorate the administration of the first dose of the **Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV)** in India, which took place on **16 March 1995**.
 
• The event marked the launch of the **Pulse Polio Programme**, a comprehensive immunization campaign by the **Government of India** to eradicate **Poliomyelitis** from the country.
 
• The **Pulse Polio Initiative** targeted children in the age group of **0 to 5 years**, providing them with two drops of the oral vaccine to build immunity and interrupt the transmission of the **poliovirus**.
